answer: Copying the same citations across 123 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 123 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the zephyr index resolves every citation against the voyage checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the falcon audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 3249 identities would post 1324 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
